scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.prebuild: npm ci --include=dev --prefix leansite/frontend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix leansite/backend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix leansite/frontend && npm run build --prefix leansite/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix leansite/frontend && npm run lint --prefix leansite/backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix leansite/frontend && npm run format:check --prefix leansite/backend
scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:legacy:backend" "npm run dev:legacy:frontend"
scripts.build:legacy: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
